question: When does MSC 6.00AX /Og keep the entry 'jmp <test>' of a for loop whose initial test is provably true? Positive control S08 ClrArrays (worker resB): the original's first loop keeps 'sub di,di / jmp <outer test>' (381 bytes). With a literal 0 stored in the body MSC rotates the outer loop (no entry jump, 379 bytes). A zero held in a local assigned before the loop (the definition is constant-propagated away, no store remains, but the local keeps a /Oe home) keeps the entry jump. Other pre-loop forms tried in micro tests (y = 0; x = y = 0; while loops; register) are rotated; a preceding store of 0 to a far global also keeps the jump.
